title: SPL/NAC · original sulcal surface models

space.name: SPL/NAC original sulcal model coordinates
space.reference: Original VTK 4.1 binary POLYDATA referenced by source atlasStructure-all.json and Slicer 4.4.0 MRML model-storage nodes.
space.correspondence: These original model surfaces share the source scene coordinate convention. This independent surface-model package makes no new correspondence to the separate MRI/label package or another atlas.
space.unit_basis: The source MRML scene identifies 3D Slicer 4.4.0. Official Slicer coordinate documentation declares native model vertices in millimeters. The source scene retains same-subject MRI with 0.75 mm spacing and model coordinates of comparable head-scale magnitude. Original point coordinates retain metric scale 1.0; no image alignment or anatomical axis conversion is asserted. Documentation: https://www.slicer.org/wiki/Slicer3%3ACoordinates

sources.title: SPL/NAC Brain Atlas
sources.citation: Halle, Talos, Jakab, Makris, Meier, Wald, Fischl and Kikinis. SPL/NAC Brain Atlas, January 2017. BWH and MGH. NIH P41 RR013218, P41 EB015902 and Google Faculty Research Award.

model_evidence: Original source-authored SPL/NAC sulcal triangle models, explicitly named and referenced by the source catalogue and MRML scene; no independent project anatomical review.
model_notes: Original source float32 points, triangle indices, point order and winding are retained exactly. Original TubeNormals, Labels and original point/cell ID arrays are also retained in source-geometry records.
The source already provides triangle surfaces; the project creates no rasterized voxels, additional thickness, smoothing, triangulation, decimation, mirroring or registration.
Native model coordinates are preserved as SOURCE_XYZ with source-unit evidence in millimeters. An MRI correspondence or anatomical coordinate-axis convention is not inferred.
scope_notes: Includes the 22 original left/right named sulcal surface models whose source values 5001 through 5022 are absent from the delivered categorical label volume.
Use only the canonical DataSource/MRML files ending sulcus1.vtk. Their unsuffixed counterparts contain identical points and triangles and are not counted again.
Source geometry selectors are marked non-authoritative by the source catalogue. These source models remain distinct from a labelled voxel parcellation or an independent anatomical review.
acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire spl_nac_sulci --data-root <existing-data-root>. Verified original members of the existing SPL/NAC archive are reused without modifying the separate MRI/label configurations.

archives.hash_basis: SHA256 pinned from the verified local acquisition; not a publisher signature
